title: daucus vulgaris var. maritimus
intro: Daucus vulgaris var. maritimus, commonly known as sea carrot or wild carrot, is a variety of wild carrot native to coastal areas and considered a medicinal plant. The health benefits of Daucus vulgaris var. maritimus include its potential in reducing inflammation and improving digestive health, making it a valuable addition to natural remedies. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Daucus vulgaris var. maritimus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses in traditional medicine.
